note: the Confluent Schema Registry client's JSSE failure (default trust, a registry whose certificate chains to no trusted root: PKIX path building failed) does not fail LOG_ENTRIES, unlike the same chain reached by an amqps or MQTT load or a webhook: the load wraps the client's failure into a plain RuntimeException message (the validation issue), so no log entry carries the SunCertPathBuilderException chain, and the broker is never reached (the avro encode fails first). Hostname, key usage and path-validation failures need a registry the JVM trusts (a trust store handed in with -Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore), and probed the same way: no throwable in any entry.

steps.note: the load: the registry (a peer node, https; its certificate chains to a CA the JVM does not trust) is untrusted; the publish on load fails at the schema registration
LOG_ENTRIES is written (200), with no throwable in any entry
